summary: Readiness review for iteration `authenticated-dashboard-shell` succeeded. The scope is clear and bounded to the authenticated dashboard shell: protected `/dashboard` experience, Home default content, collapsible left navigation with Home/Feedback Request/Configure, user identity, logout to landing page, and icon-only light/dark theme toggle. Prior prerequisites are present: registration profile persistence and Google consent gating are implemented in `src/auth.ts`, `src/app/register/actions.ts`, and `prisma/schema.prisma`; welcome email delivery is implemented and approved as a prior dependency. Current source has no `src/app/dashboard` route and auth redirects still target `/`, but those are expected implementation work for this iteration, not readiness blockers. Evidence reviewed: dashboard requirements artifact, package dependencies, Prisma schema, Auth.js config, landing/sign-in/register pages, app layout/styles, and existing registration/welcome unit tests. Checks run successfully: `npm.cmd ls next next-auth @auth/prisma-adapter @prisma/client prisma typescript --depth=0`; `npx.cmd prisma validate`; `npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false`; `npm.cmd run lint`; and `node --test .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\registration-profile-consent-source.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\welcome-email-source.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\welcome-delivery-behavior.test.mjs` with 13/13 passing. Browser verification, Playwright, app server startup, build, deployment, publishing, and real email sending were not run per task constraints.
